query: 供应商行为准则 供应商行为准则 衡量企业要求其供应商在劳工权益、人权保障、环境保护及商业道德（如反腐败、反洗钱）等方面遵循的正式规范。重点考察条款的完整性、对违约行为的处置机制以及对准则内容的培训沟通。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：准则内容完全对齐国际基准（如 RBA, ILO）；具备阶梯式的违约惩戒与终止合作机制；设立了针对供应商的常态化合规培训计划；且准则包含“向下穿透”要求（要求其供应商也签署类似协议）。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的供应商行为准则或包含在通用采购条款中，涵盖了基础的合规、廉洁与劳工要求，但缺乏具体的违约处理流程、定期的培训赋能或深度的人权/环境保护细节。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商行为准则披露，或仅有笼统的“要求供应商诚信合规”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署并执行准则的供应商数量或采购总额占比 >80%，并披露了对高风险供应商的强制签署情况。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心一级供应商签署而忽略了次级或长尾供应商，或未说明具体签署/覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商行为准则 供应商标准 违约终止 阶梯式惩戒 供应商合规培训 向下穿透 次级供应商 供应商签署 高风险供应商强制签署 采购额覆盖率 RBA ILO supplier code of conduct supplier standards RBA ILO standards breach escalation termination supplier compliance training cascading requirements flow-down requirements sub-tier suppliers supplier acknowledgement mandatory signing for high-risk suppliers 是否有正式供应商行为准则？ 是否覆盖劳工、人权、环境、反腐败等条款？ 违约惩戒与终止合作机制是什么？ 是否对供应商开展合规培训？ 是否要求向下穿透，签署覆盖多少采购额/供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商行为准则'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式供应商行为准则？ 是否覆盖劳工、人权、环境、反腐败等条款？ 违约惩戒与终止合作机制是什么？ 是否对供应商开展合规培训？ 是否要求向下穿透，签署覆盖多少采购额/供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“要求诚信合规”；仅有供应商环境标准而无劳工/道德；仅有廉洁协议单点；仅有员工行为准则；区分：供应商行为准则是综合规范；供应商环境标准、反腐败管理是其中专题深化；申诉机制是渠道；道德采购偏采购策略与冲突矿产等议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: SDGs | Actions by Beijing Enterprises Urban Resources Priorities • We attach great importance to occupational health and safe production and have established a solid HSE 1 system, as well as adopting various measures to effectively protect the health and safety of employees. Meanwhile, we are attentive to the mental health of employees and conduct various activities to protect the health and well-being of our employees. • In addition, we are capable of treating 44 out of the 46 major hazardous wastes in the National Hazardous Waste List, which greatly reduces the health risks faced by the public due to exposure to hazardous waste. • We ensure that in the recruitment and work process, we do not adopt any kind of unequal treatment of employees based on their gender. In 2021, our female employees accounted for 48% of the total employees. • We strictly abide by laws, regulations, and national and local standards to treat sewage and leachate generated during operation. For project companies that have no treatment capacities, we engage with qualified third parties for treatment to avoid water pollution as much as possible. • We have gradually selected new energy hygiene vehicles to replace traditional gasoline vehicles in project operations to speed up the construction of a clean, efficient, safe and sustainable energy supply system.

[Content]
SDGs | Actions by Beijing Enterprises Urban Resources Priorities • We attach great importance to occupational health and safe production and have established a solid HSE 1 system, as well as adopting various measures to effectively protect the health and safety of employees. Meanwhile, we are attentive to the mental health of employees and conduct various activities to protect the health and well-being of our employees. • In addition, we are capable of treating 44 out of the 46 major hazardous wastes in the National Hazardous Waste List, which greatly reduces the health risks faced by the public due to exposure to hazardous waste. • We ensure that in the recruitment and work process, we do not adopt any kind of unequal treatment of employees based on their gender. In 2021, our female employees accounted for 48% of the total employees. • We strictly abide by laws, regulations, and national and local standards to treat sewage and leachate generated during operation. For project companies that have no treatment capacities, we engage with qualified third parties for treatment to avoid water pollution as much as possible. • We have gradually selected new energy hygiene vehicles to replace traditional gasoline vehicles in project operations to speed up the construction of a clean, efficient, safe and sustainable energy supply system.

results.text: To avoid any types of social risk during transportation process that could cause unnecessary effects to the firm, the outsourcing company must carry out regular traffic safety training, conduct targeted contingency plan and organize emergency drilling regularly. Meanwhile, the Group conducts knowledge training on hazardous waste for carriers from time to time to ensure that drivers and escorts understand the general knowledge of hazardous waste and wear labor protective equipment correctly, urging carriers to effectively protect the occupational health of employees. In order to cope with the environmental risks in the transportation process, the Group has strict requirements for the outer packaging and the code of practice in the transportation process. For example, the hazardous waste labelling and signs should be complete, the characteristic information such as toxicity and harmfulness should be clearly marked, and the loading and unloading process should strictly comply with the requirements for the hazardous waste transportation, loading and unloading, and the non-compliant operation should be firmly eliminated. In particular, it should be ensured that corresponding measures such as paving the bottom of the vehicle and ensuring that leaking or dripping does not happen to the packaging container are taken before the loading of hazardous waste, so as to avoid secondary pollution.

[Section]
(3) Management of hazardous waste transportation

[Content]
To avoid any types of social risk during transportation process that could cause unnecessary effects to the firm, the outsourcing company must carry out regular traffic safety training, conduct targeted contingency plan and organize emergency drilling regularly. Meanwhile, the Group conducts knowledge training on hazardous waste for carriers from time to time to ensure that drivers and escorts understand the general knowledge of hazardous waste and wear labor protective equipment correctly, urging carriers to effectively protect the occupational health of employees. In order to cope with the environmental risks in the transportation process, the Group has strict requirements for the outer packaging and the code of practice in the transportation process. For example, the hazardous waste labelling and signs should be complete, the characteristic information such as toxicity and harmfulness should be clearly marked, and the loading and unloading process should strictly comply with the requirements for the hazardous waste transportation, loading and unloading, and the non-compliant operation should be firmly eliminated. In particular, it should be ensured that corresponding measures such as paving the bottom of the vehicle and ensuring that leaking or dripping does not happen to the packaging container are taken before the loading of hazardous waste, so as to avoid secondary pollution.
